title: Is Best-of-N the Best of Them? Coverage, Scaling, and Optimality in Inference-Time Alignment
authors_zh: Audrey Huang、Adam Block、Qinghua Liu、Nan Jiang、Akshay Krishnamurthy、Dylan J Foster
paper_type_zh: 推理数据、搜索或测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理轨迹、反馈契约、发布边界和复用风险的读者
one_line: The paper formalizes when Best-of-N overoptimizes imperfect reward models and proposes InferenceTimePessimism, a chi-squared-regularized rejection sampler evaluated across math, science, and instruction-following tasks.
该论文形式化刻画了 Best-of-N 在何时会对不完美的奖励模型过度优化，并提出以卡方正则化的拒绝采样器 InferenceTimePessimism，在数学、科学与指令遵循任务上评测。
why: It separates rollout coverage, proxy reward, true evaluation, candidate budget, and rejection decisions, exposing the fields needed to audit test-time selection traces instead of treating a final benchmark score as data-quality evidence.
inclusion_reason: Provides a formal and empirical audit of reward overoptimization in Best-of-N and an inference-time rejection-sampling alternative whose candidate, score, likelihood, budget, and acceptance fields define an auditable Track 5 trace object.

title: Problem
问题
html: Best-of-N (BoN) spends inference-time compute by sampling (N) responses from a reference policy and returning the one with the largest score from an imperfect reward model. The paper asks why increasing (N) can raise the proxy score while lowering true task reward, and whether an inference-time selector can improve without this overoptimization. Its formal unit is one fixed prompt (x), a reference policy πref, candidate responses with πref likelihoods and scalar proxy rewards, a selected response, and an evaluation-only true reward. This is a Track 5 evaluation and construction surface: the important object is the set of rollouts and selector signals under a compute budget, not a standalone answer or a released training dataset. The paper is an ICML 2025 conference paper in PMLR 267; the official record spans pages 25075–25126.

Best-of-N（BoN）通过从 reference policy 采样 (N) 个回答，并返回 imperfect reward model 评分最高的候选来使用测试时算力。论文追问：为什么增大 (N) 可能使 proxy score 上升却让真实任务回报下降，以及能否设计一种不会随算力增加而发生同类 overoptimization 的推理时选择器。其形式化记录单元是一个固定 prompt (x)、reference policy πref、带有 πref likelihood 与标量 proxy reward 的候选回答、被选回答，以及仅用于评测的 true reward。这使它成为 Track 5 的评测与构造表面：关键对象是给定计算预算下的 rollout 集合及 selector signal，而不是单个答案或已经发布的训练数据集。该文发表于 ICML 2025，收录于 PMLR 267，第 25075–25126 页。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper first models inference-time alignment through sample-and-evaluate queries: for a prompt, an algorithm may sample candidates from πref and query each candidate's policy likelihood and imperfect reward ŕ, while the true reward (r^⋆) remains unavailable to selection. BoN uses ŕ only as an argmax. InferenceTimePessimism instead targets a χ²-regularized response distribution whose unnormalized weight is πref(y|x) · relu(β^{-1}(ŕ(x,y)-λ(x))); it estimates the normalizer λ from sampled candidates and uses rejection sampling to select a response. Separating candidate budget (N) from regularization β is the core mechanism: (N) controls approximation and compute, whereas β controls pessimism about reward-model error. In the experiments the feedback contract is mixed: four scalar reward models drive selection, answer correctness supplies programmatic evaluation on GSM8K, MMLU, and MATH, and GPT-4o-mini supplies the AlpacaEval-2.0 comparison judgment.

论文首先用 sample-and-evaluate query 形式化 inference-time alignment：对一个 prompt，算法可以从 πref 采样候选，并查询每个候选的 policy likelihood 与 imperfect reward ŕ，而 true reward (r^⋆) 在选择时不可见。BoN 只按 ŕ 取最大值；InferenceTimePessimism 则以 χ²-regularized response distribution 为目标，其未归一化权重为 πref(y|x) · relu(β^{-1}(ŕ(x,y)-λ(x)))，先从候选中估计 normalizer λ，再通过 rejection sampling 选出回答。核心机制是把候选预算 (N) 与 regularization β 分离：(N) 控制近似精度和计算量，β 控制对 reward-model error 的悲观程度。实验中的反馈契约是 mixed：四个标量 reward model 驱动选择；GSM8K、MMLU 与 MATH 用答案正确性做程序化评测；AlpacaEval-2.0 则由 GPT-4o-mini 给出比较判断。

title: Method
方法
html: Algorithm 1 samples (N) candidates independently from πref, queries ŕ for every candidate, and returns the highest-scoring one. Algorithm 2 samples candidates, solves an empirical normalization equation for λ in (O(N\log N)), then accepts a candidate through rejection sampling using the nonnegative χ² weight; if sampling does not terminate within the experimental cap, the implementation defaults to BoN. The empirical study uses GSM8K test prompts, MMLU college-math and college-chemistry prompts, 512 sampled MATH test questions, and 128 sampled AlpacaEval-2.0 prompts. Task-dependent subsets of GEMMA-2-2B, LLAMA-3-3B, Mistral-7B, Phi-3-Mini, and Phi-3-Small generate about 20,000 responses per prompt at temperature 1. OASST, GEMMA-RM, LLAMA-RM, and ARMO-RM provide proxy scores. The authors bootstrap subsets of size (N) from each pool, using 50 replicates except 5 for AlpacaEval-2.0; fixed-budget comparisons use (N=2^{13}=8192), and the same (N) samples estimate the normalizer and support rejection sampling. Correctness is binary for the three answer-based benchmarks, while AlpacaEval-2.0 uses GPT-4o-mini win rate. No policy is trained by the method, and no official code or candidate-trace release was verified.

Algorithm 1 从 πref 独立采样 (N) 个候选，查询每个候选的 ŕ，并返回得分最高者。Algorithm 2 先采样候选，以 (O(N\log N)) 时间求解 λ 的经验归一化方程，再按非负 χ² 权重进行 rejection sampling；若在实验设置的上限内未能接受样本，实现会退回 BoN。实验使用 GSM8K test prompt、MMLU 的 college math 与 college chemistry prompt、从 MATH test split 随机抽取的 512 道题，以及从 AlpacaEval-2.0 抽取的 128 个 prompt。GEMMA-2-2B、LLAMA-3-3B、Mistral-7B、Phi-3-Mini 与 Phi-3-Small 按任务选取子集，并以 temperature 1 为每个 prompt 生成约 20,000 个回答；OASST、GEMMA-RM、LLAMA-RM 与 ARMO-RM 提供 proxy score。作者从候选池 bootstrap 大小为 (N) 的子集；除 AlpacaEval-2.0 仅做 5 次 replicate 外，其余任务做 50 次；固定预算对比采用 (N=2^{13}=8192)，且同一组 (N) 个样本同时用于 normalizer estimation 与 rejection sampling。三个答案型 benchmark 使用二元正确性，AlpacaEval-2.0 使用 GPT-4o-mini win rate。该方法不训练 policy，且未核验到官方代码或候选轨迹发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The theoretical evidence distinguishes coverage assumptions rather than declaring BoN universally poor. Theorems 3.1–3.2 show that under average-case coverage, BoN's candidate budget simultaneously improves coverage and increases exposure to reward-model tail errors, yielding overoptimization and a suboptimal regret rate; Theorem 3.4 shows that properly tuned BoN can reach the optimal rate under stronger uniform coverage. Theorem 4.1 gives InferenceTimePessimism an optimal regret rate up to constants and a bound that holds for all sufficiently large (N) at fixed β, while Theorem 4.2 supplies a matching query-complexity dependence up to logarithmic factors. Empirically, Figure 1 shows the predicted proxy-reward/accuracy divergence for GSM8K with OASST, and Table 1 plus Appendix B extend comparisons across tasks, policies, and reward models. The paper also reports that many fixed-budget differences are not statistically significant and that BoN can remain monotonic when a reward model is sufficiently informative. These results evaluate selectors under the studied setup; they do not prove that the sampled responses, reward scores, or unreleased traces form a high-quality reusable dataset.

理论证据区分不同 coverage assumption，而不是断言 BoN 在所有场景都较差。Theorem 3.1–3.2 表明：在 average-case coverage 下，BoN 的候选预算一方面提高覆盖，另一方面也增加接触 reward-model tail error 的机会，因此会出现 overoptimization，并得到次优 regret rate；Theorem 3.4 则说明，在更强的 uniform coverage 下，经过恰当调参的 BoN 可以达到最优 rate。Theorem 4.1 给出 InferenceTimePessimism 在常数范围内最优的 regret rate，并证明固定 β 时该界对所有足够大的 (N) 都成立；Theorem 4.2 给出除对数因子外相匹配的 query-complexity dependence。实验上，Figure 1 在 GSM8K 与 OASST 设置中展示了预测的 proxy reward 与 accuracy 分离，Table 1 和 Appendix B 又将对比扩展到更多任务、policy 与 reward model。论文同时指出，许多固定预算差异并不具有统计显著性，而且当 reward model 足够有信息时，BoN 也可能保持单调。这些结果评估的是研究设置中的 selector，不能证明采样回答、reward score 或未发布轨迹构成高质量可复用数据集。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior work had used BoN, rejection sampling, and training-time regularization, and had analyzed properties such as reward/KL trade-offs. The distinct contribution here is to study downstream true-reward regret under mismatch between an imperfect proxy reward and the unknown true reward, make reference-policy coverage an explicit limit, and give a per-prompt query-complexity account of compute. InferenceTimePessimism reuses the χ²-regularization principle associated with training-time χPO but implements the target distribution at inference time through normalizer estimation and rejection sampling. This is not a new source dataset, reward model, or benchmark. For reasoning-data curation, the direction signal is narrower and useful: a test-time selection record should retain candidates, policy likelihoods, proxy scores, (N), β, normalization and acceptance decisions, and a separately defined true-evaluation field, because the final selected answer alone hides reward hacking.

既有工作已经使用 BoN、rejection sampling 与训练时 regularization，也分析过 reward/KL trade-off 等性质。本文的区别在于：它在 imperfect proxy reward 与未知 true reward 不一致时研究下游 true-reward regret，把 reference-policy coverage 明确为性能上限，并用逐 prompt 的 query complexity 描述算力。InferenceTimePessimism 复用与训练时 χPO 相关的 χ²-regularization 原理，但通过 normalizer estimation 与 rejection sampling 在推理时实现目标分布。它不是新的源数据集、reward model 或 benchmark。对 reasoning-data 整理而言，其方向信号更窄但可操作：测试时选择记录应保留候选、policy likelihood、proxy score、(N)、β、归一化与接受决策，并将 true evaluation 单独记录，因为只有最终答案会掩盖 reward hacking 过程。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The guarantees assume sample-and-evaluate access to πref and ŕ, including response likelihoods, a bounded reward, mean-squared reward error measured under πref, and a coverage relationship to a comparator policy. The optimal β depends on coverage and reward-error quantities that may be unknown in deployment; practical robustness therefore does not remove tuning. Pessimism can be over-conservative when the proxy reward already separates correct and incorrect responses, and the experimental fallback to BoN can cause a small performance dip when rejection sampling fails at low budgets. The main answer-based tasks use binary correctness, a regime where the paper says average and uniform coverage may coincide for the chosen optimal comparator, so they do not test finer proof or reasoning quality. AlpacaEval-2.0 uses only 128 prompts, 5 replicates, and a proprietary GPT-4o-mini evaluator, making that evidence preliminary and noisy. Bootstrapping from approximately 20,000 pre-generated responses is not identical to a fresh online sampling deployment. Official code, response pools, exact seeds, runtime environment, data license, and decontamination controls were not verified, so end-to-end reproduction and trace reuse remain unresolved.

理论保证假设算法能以 sample-and-evaluate 方式访问 πref 与 ŕ，包括候选的 response likelihood；同时假设 reward 有界、reward error 以 πref 下的 mean squared error 衡量，并且 comparator policy 与 πref 之间满足 coverage 关系。最优 β 依赖部署时可能未知的 coverage 与 reward-error 量，因此实践中的稳健性并未消除调参需求。当 proxy reward 已能区分正确与错误回答时，pessimism 可能过于保守；在低预算下 rejection sampling 失败并退回 BoN，也会造成小幅性能下跌。主要答案型任务采用二元正确性；论文指出，在所选 optimal comparator 下，这一设置可能使 average coverage 与 uniform coverage 重合，因此没有检验更细粒度的证明或推理质量。AlpacaEval-2.0 仅使用 128 个 prompt、5 次 replicate 和专有 GPT-4o-mini evaluator，相应证据是初步且噪声较大的。从约 20,000 个预生成回答中 bootstrap，也不等同于部署时重新在线采样。官方代码、回答池、精确 seed、运行环境、数据许可与 decontamination control 均未核验，因此端到端复现和轨迹复用仍未解决。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For the Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data track, the paper supplies a concrete audit schema for selection trajectories: prompt and reference-policy identity; every candidate response; its policy likelihood and proxy-reward score; candidate budget (N); regularization β; estimated normalizer; per-candidate rejection probability and acceptance event; fallback path; selected response; and a true-evaluation outcome kept separate from the selection signal. Such records could support selector evaluation, reward-hacking audits, coverage studies, and comparisons of test-time compute policies. They could also help distinguish failures of generation from failures of reward modeling or selection. The evidence supports evaluation and inference-time construction use only: it does not establish SFT/RL training use, permission to redistribute benchmark-derived prompts or model outputs, or availability of the paper's experimental traces.

对 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 轨道而言，本文给出了可执行的选择轨迹审计 schema：prompt 与 reference-policy 身份、每个 candidate response、其 policy likelihood 与 proxy-reward score、候选预算 (N)、regularization β、估计 normalizer、逐候选 rejection probability 与 acceptance event、fallback 路径、selected response，以及与选择信号分开保存的 true-evaluation outcome。这类记录可用于 selector evaluation、reward-hacking audit、coverage study 和 test-time compute policy 对比，也有助于区分生成失败、reward modeling 失败与选择失败。现有证据只支持评测与推理时构造用途；它不证明可用于 SFT/RL 训练，也不证明有权再分发 benchmark-derived prompt 或模型输出，更不代表论文实验轨迹已经发布。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 2–4 together: coverage and reward-model error define the achievable regret before the algorithms are compared.
  • Algorithm 1 uses (N) for both exploration and implicit regularization; Algorithm 2 separates compute (N) from pessimism β.
  • Appendix B.1 is essential for the data object: approximately 20K temperature-1 responses per prompt-policy pair, bootstrapped into candidate subsets.
  • Treat Figure 1 and Table 1 as selector evidence, not data-quality proof; several fixed-budget differences are not statistically significant.
  • Reuse remains blocked by the unverified code/trace release, seeds, environment, license, and contamination controls.

• 应连读 Section 2–4：在比较算法之前，coverage 与 reward-model error 已经限定可达到的 regret。
  • Algorithm 1 让 (N) 同时承担探索与隐式 regularization；Algorithm 2 则把算力 (N) 与悲观程度 β 分离。
  • Appendix B.1 是理解数据对象的关键：每个 prompt-policy pair 约有 20K 个 temperature-1 回答，再从中 bootstrap 候选子集。
  • Figure 1 与 Table 1 是 selector evidence，不是 data-quality proof；多项固定预算差异不具统计显著性。
  • 由于代码/轨迹发布、seed、环境、许可与污染控制均未核验，复用仍受阻。
